description.zh: 从 Claude 本地记忆层只读生成每日书册，让用户与当前聊天角色盲选并共同翻阅旧记忆。
description.en: Builds a read-only daily volume from Claude Local Memory for blind page selection and shared rereading.

description.zh: 供 Operit 工作流低频判断邀请时机，只写入待同步事件，不直接发送消息。
description.en: Lets an Operit workflow arm an invitation event without sending chat messages directly.
